{{Quote|Too bad we don't have a Dark Jedi handy we could kill. Remember that big blast when C'baoth died?|Mara Jade|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
A '''burst''' of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|energy]] occasionally occurred when a powerful [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] or [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The resulting shockwave was sometimes very powerful, other times it was a simple dissolving of physical matter.

==History==
[[File:DarkSideBurst-TLC6.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Joruus C'baoth's death burst]]

The first known sighting of these occurrence was in [[3951 BBY]], when the remains of [[Darth Nihilus]] were consumed by a small burst of scarlet energy after his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Meetra Surik]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

In [[3637 BBY]], the Immortal Emperor known as [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] exploded in a burst of Dark Side energy, however, Valkorion's body remained behind.<ref name="KOTFE 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=1}}</ref>

Later, in [[3630 BBY]], in the mind of the Outlander, Valkorion's spirit exploded into a burst of Dark Side energy after getting himself killed by the Outlander.<ref name="FallofValkorion">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Fall of Valkorion}}</ref>

Shortly after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] won the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|chancellorship]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] released such a phenomenon upon being [[Force lightning/Legends|electrocuted]] by Palpatine after the latter fed him enough [[Wine/Legends|wine]] to make him lose consciousness. The burst was powerful enough to send ripples throughout the Force, strong enough to be felt throughout [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, unlike other Sith Lords who faced this phenomenon, Plagueis`s body remained<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

In the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19.5 BBY]], [[Nikkos Tyris]] and the other [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] leader's deaths created a dark side burst.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

In the year [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] released a similar burst after deliberately falling into the [[Ancient Abyss]] upon losing her [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|duel]] to [[Galen Marek]], though she stands out in that she was never a dark-sider whatsoever. Shortly thereafter, Marek apparently released a dark side burst when he sacrificed himself in his battle against [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], although his body was left behind (and it happened after he abandoned the dark side).<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> [[4 ABY/Legends|Six years later]], Sidious released a massive surge of blue [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy after being thrown down a reactor core shaft aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Later on the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] body dissipated after he was killed by [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Nightsister [[Ocheron]] gave off a burst of dark energy after being beheaded by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> One year later, at [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Joruus C'baoth]] also released a blast of energy after being killed by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] with [[Leia's lightsaber/Legends|Leia's lightsaber]], blowing a gaping hole in the side of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]].<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Kreia|Darth Traya]] appears to release a dark side burst in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', when the [[Meetra Surik|Exile]] throws her off of [[Trayus Core]] into a bottomless pit. It is unknown though if it was Traya releasing Dark Side energy or not, as it could have simply been her body being fed to the core of dark power on Malachor V. Regardless, this only occurs in the dark side ending of the game and is therefore not a canonical event.

Even though the Jedi Master Shaak Ti was in no way a practitioner of the Dark Side, the manner in which she died in the Sarlacc pit was noticeably similar to the dark side burst, possibly implying that it happens due to the power level of the force user and not due to force alignment.
